values.note: Rented by permit: the city's 'Application for use of Freedom Park RV Pads' asks for dates of use and a pad number, fees are paid before use, and the reservation fee is refunded only with 30 days' notice of cancellation. Call 336-623-2110 to check availability.

booking.source: https://www.edennc.us/home/showpublisheddocument/4714/638314053753900000 ('APPLICATION FOR USE OF FREEDOM PARK RV PADS'; 'Dates of use'; 'Pad Number'; 'Fees must be paid before use of park'; 'IN ORDER TO HAVE RESERVATION FEE REFUNDED FOR CANCELATION A 30 DAY NOTICE MUST BE GIVEN') + https://www.edennc.us/departments/parks-recreation ('Call 336-623-2110 to check rental availability'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.edennc.us/departments/parks-recreation and the RV pad application (no pad count stated); the count of 10 came from note prose that the city's pages do not support, so it is cleared. Read 2026-10-22

note: City of Eden Parks & Recreation RV pads within Freedom Park (splash pad, playground, ball fields, dog park). --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable by phone/permit application (City of Eden, 336-623-2110). Cleared the derived pad count (10), which no city page states. The city publishes no fee (the application's 'Rental Fee' is blank), hookups, season or pad count. Note trimmed of the pad count and the call-to-reserve line (now in booking).
flags: Thin official presence: the City of Eden's only pages are a one-line 'RV pads' amenity listing for Freedom Park and a 2023 permit application with a blank 'Rental Fee'; no nightly fee, hookups, pad count or rig length is published anywhere official. RV Life rates it $$$ (price_tier 3). Worth a call (336-623-2110) before relying on it.

Website points to the general Parks & Recreation page; the city's 'RV Park' document (the pad application) is https://www.edennc.us/home/showpublisheddocument/4714/638314053753900000. The edennc.us site answers 403 to plain HTTP.
Address: the application gives the RV pads at 121 N. Edgewood Road; the city's park list gives Freedom Park at 121 Phil Berger Ave.
